skills.name: post-work-checks
skills.description: Run through a project's post-work checklist after the agent finishes a task. Fetches todos scoped to the current project directory and acts on each one according to its status: executes 'always' todos unconditionally, evaluates the condition for 'conditional' todos and acts only when the condition is met, and skips 'disabled' todos. Use when the user asks to run post-work checks, when work is finishing and there may be a checklist defined, or when managing post-work todos. Do NOT use for general task management or project planning.
